title: Intercept article on Grusch's 2018 hospitalization
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Intercept article on Grusch's 2018 hospitalization, about 2018 (article 2023) at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was an article written a few weeks after the hearing by The Intercept. The article describes Dave's hospitalization back in 2018,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, interviewing David Grusch, a whistleblower who had testified at a government hearing about UFOs, mentions an article by The Intercept, a news outlet, published a few weeks after that hearing in 2023. Michels says the article described Grusch's hospitalization back in 2018, and he raises it because it was used to question Grusch's account.
